SELECT MAX(o.company_id) AS company_id ,o.company_code ,MAX(o.observer_type) AS observer_type ,MAX(c.wind_code) AS master_company_code ,MAX(c.full_name) AS company_name FROM ais_inv_analysis.company_observer_view o
LEFT JOIN ais_inv_analysis.t_inv_company c ON c.id = o.company_id WHERE o.company_id IS NOT NULL AND o.company_code IS NOT NULL AND o.company_code != '' AND c.wind_code IS NOT NULL AND c.wind_code != '' AND c.full_name IS NOT NULL AND c.full_name != ''
GROUP BY o.company_code

WITH company_refs AS ( SELECT wind_code AS security_code, issuer_code AS company_code FROM rrs_securityinfo WHERE issuer_code IS NOT NULL AND issuer_code != '' UNION SELECT issuer.s_info_windcode AS security_code, issuer.s_info_compcode AS company_code FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuer issuer INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = issuer.s_info_windcode WHERE (si.abs_flag = 1 OR si.security_type = 'abs') AND issuer.s_info_typecode IN (115004000, 115203000, 115200000, 115201000) AND issuer.s_info_compcode IS NOT NULL AND issuer.s_info_compcode != '' )
SELECT DISTINCT bond.wind_code AS security_code ,bond.short_name AS security_short_name ,bond.security_type ,bond.issuer_code ,bond.abs_flag ,company_ref.company_code AS trigger_company_code FROM rrs_securityinfo bond INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = bond.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 AND dst.category_type = 'bond' INNER JOIN company_refs company_ref ON company_ref.security_code = bond.wind_code WHERE company_ref.company_code IN
#{companyCode}
AND bond.security_status != 'D' AND (bond.maturity_date IS NULL OR bond.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
AND NOT (COALESCE(bond.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR bond.security_type = 'abs')
AND bond.security_type NOT IN
#{securityType}
ORDER BY company_ref.company_code ,bond.wind_code

#{securityCode}
